Commands.Description: Opens the 'Deals' tab of your saved PitchBook search. Replace <YOUR_SEARCH_ID> with your actual search ID.
Clicks the final 'Download' button in the modal.

Commands.Value: -c "DLDIR='/path/to/your/Downloads'; i=0; while [ $i -lt 60 ]; do LATEST=$(ls -t \"$DLDIR\"/PitchBook_Search_Result_Columns_*.xlsx 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [ -n \"$LATEST\" ] && [ ! -f \"$LATEST.crdownload\" ]; then break; fi; i=$((i+1)); sleep 1; done; if [ -f \"$LATEST\" ]; then BASENAME=$(basename \"$LATEST\"); mv -f \"$LATEST\" \"$DLDIR/deals_$BASENAME\"; fi"
Commands.Description: Waits for the download to complete and renames the file to 'deals_...'. Update DLDIR to your downloads folder.
Opens the 'Companies' tab of your saved PitchBook search.

Commands.Description: Moves all the downloaded and renamed files from the Downloads folder to their final destination folders. Update DLDIR and DESTDIR.
